info.name: Team 19 – Plans, tasks and internal notes
info.description:
Hana Anwar, issue #24. Tests the plans API (docs/api/plans-tasks-notes.md): creating plans from templates, who sees what, task status rules, auto-complete and reopen, reassignment, staff-only internal notes, rename and cancel.

How to run (easiest): in backend/, start the API with npm run dev, then in a second terminal run npm run postman -- plans. That creates a temporary Admin on the DEV database, runs this collection with Newman and deactivates the Admin afterwards.

In the Postman app: import this file, create an environment with adminEmail and adminPassword (an Admin on DEV), start npm run dev and run the collection. It creates its own Staff and Customer test accounts (random passwords, emails ending in @example.test) and deactivates them at the end. Never run it against the live site.
